name: Giant Panda
intro: A giant panda is a black and white bear. It lives in the mountains of China.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A giant panda is a big bear.
Its fur is black and white.
It has black ears and black patches around its eyes.
Its legs and shoulders are black too.
Its fur is thick and woolly.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Giant pandas live in China.
They live in forests high in the mountains.
Lots of bamboo grows in these forests.
Pandas are shy and stay away from people.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: A panda eats mostly bamboo.
It eats for about 12 hours every day.
It holds bamboo with a wrist bone that works like a thumb.
Its strong jaws and flat teeth crush the stems.
Sometimes it eats grass, fruit, or bugs.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A baby panda is called a cub.
A new cub is pink and has no fur.
It is about as small as a stick of butter.
Its eyes open when it is about 2 months old.
The cub stays with its mom for more than a year.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Pandas like to do somersaults.
Pandas are strong swimmers.
Pandas can bleat, honk, and growl.
Some pandas do handstands against trees.
People call the panda the bamboo bear.

vocab.meaning: A tall, tough grass with hard stems.
An animal with fur or hair that drinks milk from its mom as a baby.
